BL-2080 — A QA re-gather of a bounced ticket runs only the property files the fix reaches since the ticket's last green whole-lane run: QA's gather runs the whole property lane on every gather (389-1314 s, 75-90% of each gather on 2026-10-07), and four re-gathers that shift paid 2912 s of lane again for small fixes on top of a commit whose whole lane QA had already seen green; the whole lane still runs once per parcel and whenever the reach cannot place a change
What it solves: ## Why
Approval context: This changes what QA's last gate measures on a re-gather, so it needs your yes. FIRM: the FIRST gather of every parcel still runs the whole property lane, as BL-1877's ruling A rests on ("QA's gather still runs the whole lane once per parcel"). Only a re-gather after a bounce runs fewer files, and …
BL-2080 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-2080" (or "reject BL-2080 <reason>") to act.
